key.name: launchpad-enabled
key.description: Pinch with thumb and three fingers to open the app grid. Spread to close it again.

key.name: show-desktop-enabled
key.description: Spread with thumb and three fingers to slide every window to the edge of the screen. Pinch to bring them back.

key.name: app-expose-enabled
key.description: Swipe down with three fingers to see the windows of the current app. Off by default, as on macOS.

key.name: pinch-fingers
key.description: Thumb and three fingers usually register as four contacts, sometimes three. "any" accepts both.
